title: Structure layout: Core, Modules, and Plugins skeletons
summary: MyAPES Core now has empty Core, Module, and Plugin package folders ready for later structure moves. Sign-in, pages, permissions, and addresses behave the same.
changes: Add empty Core, Module (APES CIC, Pet Care Clinic, Shelter and Rescue), and Plugin (Tickets, Cases, Recruitment, Consultations, Pet Profiles) package skeletons with providers.
Register stable polymorphic aliases and rewrite existing stored class names so later model moves keep audit, attachments, notifications, and access grants resolving.
Include the new package trees in Cloudron release packaging and frontend/test scan paths.
Keep live web addresses and permission names unchanged; no feature controllers or screens moved yet.
version_rationale: Minor bump opens the v0.37 Structure line: new layout capability without changing user-facing behaviour, URLs, or permission strings.
validation: php artisan test --compact tests/Feature/StructureLayoutMorphMapTest.php tests/Architecture/StructureLayoutBaselineTest.php and focused authorization/cases suites.
php artisan route:list --json --except-vendor still reports 126 routes.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
composer dump-autoload and empty module/plugin providers boot without registering routes.
known_limitations: Feature code still lives under app/ until later Structure children move it into the new packages.
Architecture tests are report-only and do not fail CI yet.
On-screen wording still waits for the glossary and is unchanged.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. Empty package folders are removed with that deploy. Polymorphic type aliases and the data migration roll back with the prior release; accounts and grants remain intact because permission names and URLs did not change.
provenance: Structure layout and morph map for issue #281, pull request #298.
